integrity: The theorem is proved by a constructive integer-divisibility argument; finite enumeration is a spot-check, not the infinite proof. Historical novelty is subject to residual indexing risk.
scientific_limitations: The result is only for strictly decreasing integer subsets with empty common core; it does not classify nonempty-core spectra, non-integer ambient semigroups, or optimal realization rates. An unindexed equivalent historical result remains possible.
title: Classification of empty-core integer sumset-intersection spectra
